name: 22849 · Shenandoah, VA
findings: ZIP 22849 (Shenandoah) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22849 (Shenandoah) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22849 (Shenandoah) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
